mapper.select: SELECT c.berth_id AS berthId, c.cargo_type_name AS typeName, MAX(ct.color) AS color, c.direction AS direction, IFNULL(SUM(c.tonnage), 0) AS tonnage, IFNULL(SUM(c.loaded_tonnage), 0) AS loadedTonnage, IFNULL(SUM(c.volume), 0) AS volume, IFNULL(SUM(c.loaded_volume), 0) AS loadedVolume, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM biz_berth_cargo c LEFT JOIN biz_cargo_type ct ON ct.id = c.cargo_type_id WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.port_id = #{portId} GROUP BY c.berth_id, c.cargo_type_name, c.direction

SELECT t.berth_id AS berthId, COUNT(1) AS tripCount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = #{inTransitStatus} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inTransitCount, IFNULL(SUM(t.load_tonnage), 0) AS tonnage FROM biz_transport_trip t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.port_id = #{portId} GROUP BY t.berth_id

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(c.arrive_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, IFNULL(SUM(c.tonnage), 0) AS tonnage FROM biz_berth_cargo c WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.port_id = #{portId} AND c.direction = 'UNLOAD' AND c.arrive_time >= #{since} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(c.arrive_time, '%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(l.load_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, IFNULL(SUM(l.load_tonnage), 0) AS tonnage FROM biz_ship_load l WHERE l.deleted = 0 AND l.port_id = #{portId} AND l.status = 'LOADED' AND l.load_time >= #{since} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(l.load_time, '%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.depart_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, IFNULL(SUM(t.load_tonnage), 0) AS tonnage FROM biz_transport_trip t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.port_id = #{portId} AND t.depart_time >= #{since} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t.depart_time, '%Y-%m-%d')
